mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bmi ( mno, childId, height, weight, bmiValue, ageMonth, recordDate ) VALUES ( #{mno}, #{childId}, #{height}, #{weight}, #{bmiValue}, #{ageMonth}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT b.bmiNo, b.mno, b.childId, b.height, b.weight, b.bmiValue, b.ageMonth, b.recordDate, c.birth AS birthDate, c.gender FROM bmi b JOIN child c ON b.childId = c.childId WHERE b.mno = #{mno} AND b.childId = #{childId} ORDER BY b.recordDate DESC

SELECT b.bmiNo, b.mno, b.childId, b.height, b.weight, b.bmiValue, b.ageMonth, b.recordDate, c.birth AS birthDate, c.gender FROM bmi b JOIN child c ON b.childId = c.childId WHERE b.mno = #{mno} AND b.childId = #{childId} AND b.recordDate BETWEEN CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59') ORDER BY b.recordDate DESC
SELECT b.bmiNo, b.mno, b.childId, b.height, b.weight, b.bmiValue, b.ageMonth, b.recordDate, c.birth AS birthDate, c.gender FROM bmi b JOIN child c ON b.childId = c.childId WHERE b.bmiNo = #{bmiNo}
SELECT * FROM bmi WHERE childId = #{childId} ORDER BY recordDate DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE bmi SET height = #{height}, weight = #{weight}, bmiValue = #{bmiValue}, ageMonth = #{ageMonth} WHERE bmiNo = #{bmiNo}
